connectors.name: FortiNAC Device
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: FortiNAC appliance — SSH/CLI + REST API (72 tools). v0.12 adds 5 group writes: add/remove devices to/from a group, copy group, update GroupDto, delete group. For host/port/user groups use call_api with system/group/add-members (needs type byte). v0.12.1: call_api preserves slashes in path (url_encoding: none) + leaves out empty body so GET works with default body_json="". v0.12.2: list_hosts moves optional query params (filters, start, count, sortKey, sortDir) from URL template into spec.query — Forge drops unset filters cleanly so LLM omitting filter no longer 400s. v0.12.3: call_api description warns against ? in path; list_hosts notes large-scan 500 workaround. v0.12.4: run_command exposes timeout_sec arg (default 60s, bump for slow diagnose commands).

connectors.name: FortiNCM Device
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: FortiNCM (Network Configuration Manager) appliance — central manager for FortiNAC fleets. Requires NCM 8.0.0+ (older builds return 404 on most calls; call check_compatibility(host) first). SSH/CLI + REST (78 tools). Auto-auth via bearer-token-exchange — only username/password in settings. v0.3.3: call_api fixes URL building — manifest now prepends /api/v3/, path is no-encoding-slashes (matches nac.call_api convention).

connectors.name: FortiNAC Test Platform
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: FortiNAC TP browser connector — NFR read/edit + weekly status + comments, plus automation (labs, testcases, pytest runs, results) and get_lab_devices. v0.7.x uses the v2 /adc/automation/pytest/ API; list_testcases walks the new recursive tree shape and supports search/prefix filters.

connectors.name: Jenkins
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Jenkins REST API connector — trigger builds, monitor status, fetch console logs and artifacts. Server-side via API token. Folder-nested jobs supported. Multiple Jenkins instances in one install.

connectors.name: MantisBT
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Read + comment on MantisBT bugs from the user's logged-in browser session. Search, list attachments, download files, post notes. v0.26.1 — search_bugs description fix: surface `resolution` arg in the dedicated-params list and explicitly distinguish it from `status` (LLMs were misreading 'resolution=open/reopened' as 'status=open' and getting back the wrong bug set). v0.26.0 was the underlying URL-direct rewrite (GET view_all_set.php with URL params — Mantis writes its own HttpOnly cookie).

connectors.name: GitLab
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: GitLab REST API connector via Personal Access Token (encrypted at rest). 25+ tools for issues, MRs, projects, pipelines, branches, files, notes, todos. v1.7.1 adds 2fa_verify hint in description for Fortinet internal users.

connectors.name: Microsoft Teams
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Read + send messages in the Teams web client (v2 UI) via the user's logged-in session. Channels, group chats, 1:1 DMs.

connectors.name: PMDB
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Read-only DOM extraction from PMDB (Product Management Database) using the user's logged-in browser session.

connectors.name: GitHub API
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: GitHub REST API connector — runs entirely server-side. Optional PAT for private repos / higher rate limits.

connectors.name: SCAP (Fortinet PSIRT)
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Fortinet PSIRT SCAP — /reports/ffi. v0.3: extract_issues moved fully browser-side — fetches the artifacts zip in your logged-in tab (same-origin cookie auto-attached), parses zip + CSVs inline via DecompressionStream + minimal RFC4180 parser. No sessionid setting needed. Returns known_mantis[] + new_sast[] filtered by severity.

connectors.name: Black Duck
connectors.author: forge
connectors.description: Synopsys Black Duck SCA — 6 read tools (projects, versions, risk profile, vulnerable BOM components, components). Uses Forge core's new bearer-token-exchange auth: configure base_url + long-lived API token, Forge auto-exchanges for ~2h bearer JWT and caches.
